segments.comment: C-first corrected route for music.c:do_earthquake -> pray.c:desecrate_altar. The first route reached a locked door before the source-mapped altar. This independently reruns the selected level seed, wishes a charged wand of opening before travel, opens both observed locked doors, reaches the ordinary generated altar at map coordinate (25,13), steps one square away, then wishes a charged drum of earthquake and plays it repeatedly. Keep only if C reaches the ALTAR arm and desecrate_altar.

comment: C-first correction after attempt5: the independent fresh differential found its first mismatch at the nearby polymorph-trap activation, before the intended earthquake effect, so this route bypasses every visible ^ trap on the source map. It opens both locked doors with the charged slot-p wand and reaches ordinary floor beside the generated altar. Five extra spaces after each drum play absorb any C pagers caused by pit/fountain/altar messages without consuming a game turn when no page is present. Keep only if the first mismatch is source-distinct and the altar branch is reached.
